method: Targeted curriculum review of only 4.2.2.2–4.2.2.6 against existing cached AQA 8464 headings in work/aqa-704/biology.json, using Q/R/S adequacy standard. Full requires adequate teaching/revision, direct assessment with answers/feedback, skills, tier and relevant visual/data/evaluation support. Presence of a keyword or count alone is insufficient. No full Biology rediscovery.
